title: stage transitions: game menu
shortDescription: A title menu that turns into a game through a transition of your choice, a pause menu over the frozen level, and back to the title through black
description: One `StageDirector` is the renderer of the `Display`. It holds a **stack of layers** and composes it in one pipeline, bottom to top, with premultiplied alpha. The bottom slot holds a starfield from start to end; above it the **title** — a `Stage2D` with the chrome font and a ship — turns into the **level** through `director.replace(title, level, {effect, duration, easing})`: only that slot runs the transition, the stars stay. The level is a `StageRenderer` of two stages, the world and the HUD, with a **bloom of its own** that the director composes like any other layer; the builder of the demo keeps the alpha of the layer, so the stars shine through. *Escape* runs `director.push(pause, {below: 'freeze'})`: the level keeps its last picture under the menu, neither updated nor drawn, and `pop()` lets it run on from there. *Q* quits to the title through `dipToColor()`. Pick the effect, the duration and the easing in the panel; *freeze outgoing* holds the last picture of the layer that goes. See [Stage transitions](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/stages.md#stage-transitions).
